turnaround_reason: Forward Air destroyed its balance sheet with the ~$2.1B January 2024 Omni Logistics acquisition, taking on ~$1.4B of debt (net debt ~$1.68B, ~5.5x EBITDA). The equity is a leveraged stub that recovers only if a strategic review, asset sales, or a full sale deleverages it.
bullish_points: Strategic review live with Goldman Sachs; piecemeal deleveraging underway (an Omni unit sold July 2026 for ~$16.5M with an $8-10M gain)
Record Q2 operating revenue ~$673M and ~$93M consolidated EBITDA — the operating business generates cash
EV/revenue ~1.0 and positive FCF (~$87M); analyst mean target $28 vs ~$17 price (thin, only 2 analysts)
Asset-light model with real scale in expedited LTL if leverage is tamed
bearish_points: The full-company sale process ENDED WITHOUT A BUYER — the primary bull catalyst already failed
Q2 carried a $244M goodwill impairment on Omni → $201M operating loss, $246M net loss; the huge 'EPS beat' (1.53 vs -0.15) is one-time gains, not run-rate
Negative book value (P/B -4.9) and ~4.5x financial leverage; deleveraging depends on selling assets into a soft freight market
Freight cycle still weak; execution risk on carving up Omni/Intermodal without fire-sale pricing
catalyst: Definitive divestiture(s) of Omni/Intermodal segments at prices that materially cut net debt
suggested_trade: Spot only, small speculative. This is a distressed deleveraging bet, not a core position. Existing research note in data/research/FWRD.md.
key_risk: Asset sales come too slow or too cheap and the debt load forces dilution or restructuring, wiping the equity stub.
would_skip_if: Leverage stays above 5x into 2027 or a dilutive equity raise is signaled.
